Provincial Councils Notifications
WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Notification

I, Prasanna Ranatunga, as the Chief Minister and Minister in charge of the subject of Local Government of the WesternProvince shall hereby enforce the regulations relevant to Allowance Payments for Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Councilorsof Municipal Councils as per power assigned to me under Section 289 of Municipal Councils Ordinance (Chapter 252) readwith clause 2 of Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, These regulations shall come into effectfrom 01.11.2014 and the regulations put into force from 01.12.2008 in relation to this matter as published in the Gazette Paperof the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 1578/4 dated 01st December 2008 will be repealed with effect from thedate immediately previous to 01.11.2014.
PRASANNA RANATUNGA,Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Order,
Land, Education, Local Government and Provincial Administration,Manpower and Employment, Engineering Services and Information
of the Western Province Provincial Council.
At Shrawasthi Mandiraya,Sir Marcus Fernando Mawatha,Colombo 07,19th November 2014.
REGULATIONS
1.These regulations shall be named as Regulations relating to payment of allowances to Mayors, Deputy Mayorsand Councilors of Municipal Councils of the Western Province.

2.For the Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Councilors appointed to Municipal Councils of the Western Province anallowance as stated below shall be paid from 01st of November 2014. This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

Mayor-Rs. 30,000.00Deputy Mayor-Rs. 25,000.00Councilor-Rs. 20,000.00
3.(1)In the following occasions, a Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Councilor of a Municipal Council shall not beliable to receive the above allowance.
(i)Non-participation at council meetings and committee meetings of the month related to the allowance-payment without obtaining the approval of the Council.
(ii)Has flown out of country on a personal matter, external to council duties.
(iii)Being jailed or in custody on certain criminal charge.

(2)Notwithstanding the matters stated in Sub-paragraph (i) of Paragraph (1) of this order, where a Mayor,Deputy Mayor or Councilor engage in official duty on formal approval, he shall not be deprived of hisallowance on the reason of non-participation at council meetings.

CORRECTION NOTICE
Transfer of Stamp Duty Statute of the Northern Provincial Council No. 02 of 2014

IN the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1886/60 of 31.10.2014, the Notification published by the Northern Provincial Council, in the2nd line of English Version of the both notices printed incorrectly as “The Honourable Governor has given is assent”.
